description: A subtype of epidermolysis bullosa caused by fragility within the superficial layers of the epidermis.
symptoms: Recurrent blistering after friction or trauma
causes: Inherited defects in epidermal structural proteins

appearance.general: Blisters usually develop at sites of friction or minor trauma.

warning_signs: Widespread blistering, dehydration, infection, or mucosal involvement requires medical assessment.
prevention: Reduce friction and trauma to affected areas.
